sloka: ध्रुवम् अद्य पुरी रामायोध्या युधिनाम् वर ।निष्प्रभा त्वयि निष्क्रान्ते गत चन्द्रा इव शर्वरी ॥२-५३-२९॥
transliteration: dhruvam adya purī rāmāyodhyā yudhinām vara ।niṣprabhā tvayi niṣkrānte gata candrā iva śarvarī ॥2-53-29॥

translations.english: O Rama, foremost of warriors, it is certain that since your departure, the city of Ayodhya must be lustreless like night without the Moon.
